scripts.dev: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('frontend')) { require('child_process').execSync('cd frontend && npm run dev', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('npm run dev', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
scripts.build: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('frontend')) { require('child_process').execSync('cd frontend && npm install && npm run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('npm run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
scripts.start: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('frontend')) { require('child_process').execSync('cd frontend && npm run start', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('npm run start', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
